activities.name: Json
activities.whenToUse: Use for JSON content at ItemSignal %.@. The original Plan is passed to the JSON helper; omit Format or set Json for single-value parsing, or set JsonArray for array aggregation.

properties.description: Select Json versus JsonArray parsing in the JSON formatting helper.
properties.whenToUse: Omit or set Json to parse a single JSON value; set JsonArray to parse each input and return an array. This setting controls the helper for both Json and JsonArray activities.

result.description: When both verbs call Invoke-FormatJson; Plan.Format selects actual JSON mode; Json or JsonArray parse returns nonnull value.
When both verbs call Invoke-FormatJson; Plan.Format selects actual JSON mode; Plan.Format=JsonArray with zero inputs or parsed null elements.

resultNotes: FormatCondenser: success can have no Result (Plan.Format=Json parses JSON null, or unsupported Plan.Format has no SetResult)
FormatCondenser: Json/JsonArray share helper and Plan.Format selection; JsonArray aggregate remains present even when empty

activities.name: JsonArray
activities.whenToUse: Use for JSON content at ItemSignal %.@ when array aggregation is intended, and set Plan.Format to JsonArray. This activity also passes the original Plan to the same helper, whose omitted Format defaults to Json.
activities.description: Route JSON content through the formatter; Plan.Format selects Json or JsonArray parsing.

properties.description: Select Json versus JsonArray parsing in the JSON formatting helper.
properties.whenToUse: Set JsonArray to parse each input and return an array. Omitted Format defaults to Json even for the JsonArray activity; Json parses one JSON value.

result.description: When both verbs call Invoke-FormatJson; Plan.Format selects actual JSON mode; Json or JsonArray parse returns nonnull value.
When both verbs call Invoke-FormatJson; Plan.Format selects actual JSON mode; Plan.Format=JsonArray with zero inputs or parsed null elements.

resultNotes: FormatCondenser: success can have no Result (Plan.Format=Json parses JSON null, or unsupported Plan.Format has no SetResult)
FormatCondenser: Json/JsonArray share helper and Plan.Format selection; JsonArray aggregate remains present even when empty

activities.name: Xml
activities.whenToUse: Use for XML content at ItemSignal %.@. An XmlDocument input is passed through; other content is sent to the XML parser. This activity does not read Plan.Format.

result.description: When resolved content is XMLDocument or text/object parseable by Invoke-FormatXml; XMLDocument input is passed through or helper parses XML.

activities.name: Text
activities.whenToUse: Use for content at ItemSignal %.@ when text output is needed. XML documents become OuterXml, PSCustomObject values become compressed JSON, and other native values pass through unchanged. This activity does not read Plan.Format.

result.description: OuterXml [computed]. When resolved content type controls serialization; XMLDocument input.
compressed JSON [computed]. When resolved content type controls serialization; PSCustomObject input.
When resolved content type controls serialization; other native input.
